# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Match those records with what has been reported on the WorkCover Register.
3. Use the information from both to complete the Employer's report form.

Employers are required to notify the WorkCover Authority of Queensland (WorkCover) using the Notification of Injuries Register or the Reportable Incidents Register within 8 days of becoming aware of a reportable incident or work-related death.

Use the procedures outlined below to complete the employers report form. Information from the Notification of Injuries Register and the Report of Incidents Register will have already been transferred to the employers report form.

# Start with the incident records

These include your incident report forms and investigation reports. When information is recorded on your internal forms it helps employers to:

\- Identify hazards and reduce the risks of a similar incident occurring again

\- Assess the hazards in your workplace

\- Reduce the likelihood of further reportable incidents

\- Explain to WorkCover how, when and where the incident
